records.issue_text: Test cleanup in OrganizationCacheTest registers removal against the nonexistent alias 'alias' instead of 'idp-alias-' + i, causing cleanup remove() calls to hit a 404, leaking the 20+ created IDPs and org links into the shared test realm and contaminating subsequent tests
records.rationale: In OrganizationCacheTest.testCacheIDPForLogin(), inside the loop creating 20 IDPs with alias "idp-alias-" + i, cleanup is registered as `getCleanup().addCleanup(testRealm().identityProviders().get("alias")::remove);` (literal "alias"), not the created alias. The same pattern occurs for the extra IDP "idp-alias-20". This will not remove the created IDPs during cleanup (likely causing failed/404 removals and leaked test data into the shared realm), contaminating subsequent tests.
